text:
Maria (CS): quick weekly pulse for AtlasCo dedicated pool — noticed some onboarding-driven backpressure overnight. GPU hours +32% vs last week, peak saturation 94%, avg queue depth 6. P95 latency 320ms, error rate jumped to 1.1% for generation calls. Spend +22%.

Ajay (SRE): thanks — do we know which jobs drove the bump? any big batched embedding jobs?

Maria (CS): looks like their migration script kicks off large batched embedding jobs between 02:00-04:00 UTC. Batch size ~2048 per request; prefix cache hit rate fell to ~55% during that window.

CapacityBot: [ALERT] atlas-prod pool saturation >90% for 45m (2024-11-13 03:10 UTC). Autoscale invoked x2, queued requests peaked at 9.

Sophie (AE): FYI customer is mid-onboarding + trial renewal in 6 weeks. If we keep seeing spend spikes + errors, renewal risk rises. We should offer a cost/throughput plan.

Nate (PM): can we get a short breakdown: GPU hours by day, peak saturation timeline, queue depth histogram, and the request types (generation vs embeddings)? i'll add to the renewal risk deck.

Ajay (SRE): i'll pull logs — running quick query now: `select bucket, count(*) as calls, avg(latency) from invocations where tenant='atlas' group by bucket` — will paste results in a minute. Early look: embeddings = 68% of calls during spike window.

Liam (Oncall): checked runbook, temporary mitigations: 1) throttle concurrent embedding requests from atlas tenant 2) enable aggressive KV prefix caching for atlas model variants 3) hold burst tokens for 4 hours. Runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/atlas-capacity

Maria (CS): suggested customer outreach: ask Atlas engine team to stagger migration batches and reduce per-request batch size to 512. Offer a short enablement session to review batching + quantization tradeoffs.

Sophie (AE): can we draft a short note with concrete options (1. stagger + reduce batch size, 2. temp reserved burst, 3. enable prefix caching) and estimated cost impact? I'll send to Atlas and attach an invite.

Ajay (SRE): pasted the query results: embeddings dominated (68%), peak queue depth 9 at 03:22 UTC, p95 latency 320ms -> p95 generation 260ms, p95 embeddings 410ms. Error spikes were mostly 429/503 during queue peaks. Logs: `rate_limited` and `kv-miss`.

CapacityBot: Suggested action: `increase-burst-capacity atlas-prod by 1x for 6h` — run `!approve` to execute (requires ops approval).

Liam (Oncall): i can approve a 6h burst if CS wants it while we schedule enablement. approvals: @Liam (Oncall) :thumbsup:

Maria (CS): let's do a 6h burst tonight to reduce customer errors, but require atlas to join enablement + follow the batching guidance. Sophie — can you coordinate invite for tomorrow?

Sophie (AE): on it. i'll draft the email now and cc @Nate for renewal context.

Nate (PM): thanks. once we have telemetry export (Ajay), i'll model cost vs outcomes for the renewal brief.

Ajay (SRE): exporting CSV to shared drive: `s3://redwood-exports/atlas/weekly-capacity-2140000123.csv`. includes per-minute saturation, queue depth, and error codes.

Maria (CS): action items: [1] run 6h burst tonight (Liam) [2] enable prefix caching and throttle embedding concurrency (Ajay) [3] draft customer note + schedule enablement (Sophie) [4] telemetry export for renewal model (Ajay/Nate). i'll follow up in tomorrow's check-in with status.

Liam (Oncall): confirmed — scheduled burst 2024-11-13 22:00 UTC for 6h.

Maria (CS): thanks all. will close the loop after the enablement and share updated utilization numbers in next week's pulse. :white_check_mark:
